title: Find-machine phase redirection
statement: Let $\Gamma$ and $A$ be types, let $m>0$, let $\delta:A\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to A$, choose $a_0\in A$, and let $\mathrm{acc}:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Define a partial redirection from a find-machine phase and its control state to a new phase and control state as follows: an empty read control halts, a false read control goes to exit, and a true read control begins a forward scan at index $0$ with state $a_0$; a completed scan either skips to the next index with updated state $\delta(a,\mathrm{none})$, goes to exit if it is the last index and $\mathrm{acc}(a)$ holds, or skips at the last index with state $a$; a completed skip advances to the next scan index when one remains and otherwise returns to the read phase. All other phase-control combinations halt.
